cadence.why: Builds and runs every runner the project has. Done means a fresh full run with ok: true.

cadence.when: After editing project.godot, a csproj, export presets or an add-on
cadence.why: Finds setup mistakes that break CI or ship a broken build.

cadence.when: After a UI, scene or text change
cadence.why: Real screenshots, text cut off in other languages, colour-blind views, the palette.
Loudness of each sound and of the mix.
The CI workflow runs the same two.

cadence.when: At the end of a milestone
cadence.why: A build that starts, frame times and draw calls, then heat maps from play sessions.

cadence.when: Before an alpha or beta, and for a Steam Deck or server game
cadence.why: The Deck check at 1280x800, and memory over a long session.
Store art and Steam files, the credits file, a versioned build.
Where the game stands, the next gates, and how the kit's own runs are going.
